finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: User inputs a filename that contains shell metacharacters (e.g., '; rm -rf /')
finding.assumptions: The filename is directly used in a system call or command execution.

parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked that the code only uses the untrusted input to construct an ifstream object, which opens a file path directly with the OS API (e.g., std::ifstream). No system call or command construction (such as system(), execve(), or a shell invocation) is present, so the input is never interpreted by a shell. Consequently, characters like ';' or other shell metacharacters are treated as ordinary file name characters, not as command delimiters.
